info.name: PickleCoach API (By Type)
info.description: Endpoints grouped by resource/type. Use for finding a specific endpoint, debugging, and sharing with frontend. For flow-based testing use PickleCoach API (By Flow).

request.description: Roles: Any (no auth). Check if the server and database are running.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Auth endpoints. Register/Login = no auth; Profile/Switch Role/Delete = authenticated.

request.description: Roles: Any (no auth). Login and receive JWT token.
Roles: Student, Coach, Admin. Get current authenticated user's profile.
Refresh an expired JWT token
Roles: Any (no auth). Register a new user account. Optional: avatar_url (valid URL, max 255 chars).
Request password reset link via email
Reset password using token from forgot-password email
Roles: Student, Coach, Admin. Update current authenticated user's profile.
Roles: Student, Coach, Admin. Change password using the current password and a new password. Revokes all existing tokens.
Roles: Student, Coach, Admin. Request a verification email to be sent to the current user's email address.
Roles: Any (no auth). Confirm email verification using the token from the verification email.
Roles: Student, Coach, Admin. Start 2-step email change flow. Sends confirmation to the NEW email address.
Roles: Any (no auth). Confirm email change using the token from the email sent to the new address.

Roles: Student, Coach (not Admin). Switch account between student and coach without deleting. Body: role = 'student' or 'coach'. Response includes new token — save it (test script sets auth_token) for subsequent requests.
Invalidate current and all other tokens for this user (increments token_version). Client should discard the token after calling.
Roles: Student, Coach (not Admin). Soft delete the current user's account. Sets deleted_at and is_active false; coach profile also soft-deleted.

request.description: Roles: Coach. Update coach profile. Path :id is the coach's **user id** (same as GET /coaches/:id).
Roles: Any (no auth). Get coach availability. Path :id is the coach's **user id**.
Roles: Coach. Create coach availability slot. Body `coach_id` is the coach's **user id**.

Roles: Coach. Delete own availability slot (hard delete). Set availability_id from Create Availability (data.id) or Get Coach Availability (data[0].id). For admin fix use DELETE /api/admin/coaches/:coachId/availability/:id.

Roles: Coach. Link an existing court to my courts. Create courts with POST /api/courts first (coaches auto-linked when they create). Body: court_id (required), optional rate_modifier, preferred, notes. For admin fix use DELETE /api/admin/coaches/:coachId/courts/:linkId.
Roles: Coach. List my linked courts. For admin view use GET /api/admin/coaches/:coachId/courts.

variable.description: Coach court link id from GET /api/coaches/me/courts (data[].id)

request.description: Roles: Coach. Unlink a court from my courts. :id is the coach_court_location id from List My Courts (data[].id). For admin fix use DELETE /api/admin/coaches/:coachId/courts/:linkId.
Roles: Coach, Admin. Initiate Stripe Connect onboarding. Coach: coach_id ignored (uses your id). Admin: set coach_id to coach's user id.
Roles: Coach, Admin. Get Stripe Connect account status for coach.
Roles: Student, Admin (coaches get 403). List/search coaches. Query params: lat, lng (optional – center for radius), radius (miles), skill_level, min_rating, page, limit.
Roles: Any (no auth). Get coach details by ID. Path :id is the coach's **user id** (users.id). Set `coach_id` env var to that user id.
Roles: Any (no auth). Search courts (with lazy import from OpenStreetMap if no results).

request.description: Roles: Admin. List audit log entries with optional filters for user_id, action, and table_name.
Roles: Admin. Get admin alerts.
Roles: Admin. Resolve an alert.
Roles: Admin. Create a new admin user.

query.description: Filter by full name or email (case-insensitive, partial match).
Include soft-deleted users. Omit or disable for non-deleted only.

request.description: Roles: Admin. Get all users (non-deleted by default). Query params: include_deleted=true to include soft-deleted; search to filter by full name or email (case-insensitive).
Roles: Admin. Get user by ID. Non-admins should use GET {{api_url}}/auth/profile.

Roles: Admin. Update user. Optional body fields: full_name, email (must be unique), phone, timezone, avatar_url (URI or "" to clear), is_active, role, deleted_at (null to undelete). Cannot activate a deleted user without also setting deleted_at: null.
Roles: Admin. Manually adjust a user's reliability score.
Roles: Admin. List courts linked to a coach (for support/moderation). Path coachId = coach's user id.

variable.description: Coach court link id from GET /admin/coaches/:coachId/courts (data[].id)

request.description: Roles: Admin. Unlink a court from a coach (e.g. wrong court linked). coachId = coach user id, linkId = coach_court_location id.
Roles: Admin. Delete a coach's availability slot (e.g. wrong times). coachId = coach user id, id = availability record id.
Roles: Admin. Delete user (soft delete).
Roles: System (Stripe webhook; no user auth; uses Stripe-Signature verification).
